DocuMind

RAG document intelligence platform

A retrieval-augmented generation platform where teams upload documents and ask questions in natural language, getting grounded answers with source citations.

Problem

Teams lose time searching long documents for answers. A plain LLM chat over documents is fast but can hallucinate, so answers need to be grounded in the source and traceable back to it.

Solution

An ingestion pipeline that chunks, embeds, and indexes documents into pgvector, and a query path that combines hybrid retrieval, re-ranking, and prompt engineering to produce citation-backed answers streamed to a chat UI.

Architecture

Technical implementation

01
Ingestion
Pipeline that chunks, embeds, and indexes 1M+ passages into a pgvector store.
02
Retrieval
Hybrid semantic + keyword search for high-relevance results, followed by re-ranking.
03
Generation
LangChain orchestration with prompt engineering that produces grounded, citation-backed answers.
04
Delivery
Streaming Next.js chat UI and a FastAPI backend with JWT auth, containerized with Docker and deployed on AWS.

Engineering challenges

  1. Retrieving the right passages

    Approach
    Combined semantic vector search with keyword search over the pgvector index, then re-ranked candidates before generation.
    Result
    Answer relevance raised to ~92%.

  2. Reducing hallucinations

    Approach
    Grounded every response in retrieved passages with prompt engineering and returned source citations with each answer.
    Result
    Citation-backed answers users can verify.

  3. Keeping the chat responsive

    Approach
    Streamed answers to a Next.js UI from a containerized FastAPI backend on AWS.
    Result
    Scalable, low-latency inference.
